description.en: The Bot team every Automagik product builds on, and the welcome that connects your AI.

title.en: Personal use under the vendor's terms

description.en: A team of long-lived Bots in DSH: the Main Bot and its Bots, group chats, memory and settings. Omni's channels and canvases build on it. Keeps its files in ~/.automagik/bots, never in your DSH profile. Formerly @automagik/omni-dsh (Omni team).

The octopus welcomes you, puts your team together and connects your AI: DeepSeek, an API key, Codex, Claude, Kimi or a CLIProxyAPI gateway, through DSH's own sign-ins. Formerly @automagik/omni-ai-dsh.
Genie joins your Bot team and grants wishes: each wish is a Task that works in its own git worktree of your project and commits the result on a wish/… branch. Needs the Bot team and git.

Sign in with the AI plans you already pay for, several accounts each: Antigravity, Cursor, Kiro, GLM, Qwen, ERNIE, Spark, JetBrains AI, Perplexity, Replit and Cody. Automagik's reviewed fork of GooDAnDReaDY's plugin, without the vendors DSH's own sign-ins already cover and without its own updater.
The official Claude Code CLI as a model provider.

Use the models of your own DSH in Unfold, and let Unfold follow the agents you pick. Serves your DSH's model routes to apps on this computer as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on 127.0.0.1, behind a key made at each start. Unfold sees your sessions' names and status, and what your agents say only for the sessions you subscribe it to. It can draft a next message for an agent, which is sent only when you click Send in DSH. Your sign-ins and their tokens stay in DSH. It never answers approvals and runs no tools. Part of Unfold; works with the Unfold app.

Brazilian Portuguese for DSH. Adds Português (Brasil) to Settings › General › Language, and a browser set to Brazilian Portuguese opens DSH in it. Translates what a first session shows: the sidebar, the composer and messages, approvals and questions, the plugin pages and the general settings. Anything it doesn't translate yet stays in English.

Part of Unfold; works with the Unfold app. What Unfold can do, and how well. A read-only map of each capability, modality and benchmark row, computed only from bench scorecards joined to their manifests: a cell without evidence says so, and runs that are not comparable are listed apart with why. Shows the latest measured candidate as a measurement, never as proof of what is deployed. Writes nothing and opens no connection of its own.

Part of Unfold; works with the Unfold app. How Unfold is set up right now, read-only: backend and model, the prompt revision (shown only when it is proven against what the agent sent), voice and device state and the model context, each with its source and how fresh it is. A value nobody reports says unknown, and a value past its lease says stale; nothing is assumed. Writes nothing and opens no connection of its own: it reads the Unfold session and event plugins.

See what Unfold's agent is doing, inside the Unfold instance's DSH. Adds two right-sidebar tabs: Unfold events, every event the agent sends in plain words, newest first; and Unfold, its presence, which says what it is doing right now. It only watches: it attaches to the agent read-only, through the address Unfold publishes for its own instance, and opens no port. Outside an Unfold instance it has nothing to show. Part of Unfold; works with the Unfold app.

Part of Unfold; works with the Unfold app. See what Unfold's agent is doing, one plain sentence per event, grouped into episodes. Each row opens an audit panel with its ids, cause chain and source. It only shows: it sends nothing to the agent, and the suggestions you write stay in a local file.

Part of Unfold; works with the Unfold app. What Unfold heard, thought, said and did, as one ledger with a timing overview and an inspector, in Unfold's own Session. A fork of DeepSeek's Trajectory view that reads Unfold's Mind stream (from Unfold's Mind plugin) and opens no other connection. It only reads, and DeepSeek's own Trajectory view stays as it is.

Talk to Unfold from DSH, inside the Unfold instance's DSH. Unfold's rolling session is one DSH conversation: what you type and send in its composer goes to Unfold once, only through Unfold's own control endpoint, and Unfold's reply streams back as a chat bubble. DSH makes no model call for it. Spoken turns are shown as bubbles, never sent, and nothing an event says is ever sent for you. Outside an Unfold instance nothing is sent, and the chat says so. Part of Unfold; works with the Unfold app.

Unfold inside DSH, on the Automagik Bot team. Adds the Unfold Bot, drawn in Unfold's own clay, which follows and carries on the work you do with Unfold through the Unfold plugins and the Unfold bridge. Install it from the welcome's team step, which brings those plugins with it. Part of Unfold; works with the Unfold app.
